crossRefs.note: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then isn’t the health of the daughter of my people…
For Yahweh says, “Your hurt is incurable. Your wound is grievous.
There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines.
Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed! Wail for her! Take balm for her pain. Perhaps she may be healed.
Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

translations.web: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,
translations.bsb: She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail. Instead, her condition had only grown worse.
translations.kjv: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
